name: Wiz
source:
Wiz is a powerful lich wizard who, despite being one of the Devil King's generals, is a timid and kind woman who uses her powers to assist civilians and lead lost spirits to the afterlife. She runs an unsuccessful magic shop which is later managed by Vanir, in which she is treated like a slave worker.

[From Wikipedia]
